uh_v151_d: Quality update: dark mode and switch fixes, startup apps, clipboard pinning and notification empty state.
notif_v16_body: Mail is fully rewritten, Calendar and To Do are new, and Personalization adds theme presets, accent colors, wallpapers, taskbar alignment, icon size and density.
wn_desc16: 16.0 adds Mail, Calendar and To Do, and makes personalization previewable in real time.
wn_mail_d: Inbox, Sent, Drafts and Starred folders with compose, validation, sending animation and auto-reply.
wn_cal_d: Month view, today highlight, per-day events shown as dots on the grid.
wn_todo_d: Add, complete and delete tasks, filtered by All / Active / Completed.
wn_pers_d: Theme presets, accent color, wallpaper, taskbar alignment, icon size, labels, transparency and density — all live.
wn_prefs_d: Your theme and interface choices are stored and restored next time.
mail_reply_body: Got it, thanks for your message! I'll reply in detail soon.
cal_event_ph: Add an event on this day
uh_v16_d: Mail rewrite, Calendar, To Do and Personalization.
notif_v17_body: Introducing Copilot, Start menu recommendations, desktop context menus 2.0, smart snap fill, Task View virtual-desktop wallpapers, hidden tray icons, and an OEM boot animation.
wn_desc17: 17.0 brings Copilot and pushes the desktop experience another big step closer to real Windows.
wn_copilot_d: Open the side assistant from the taskbar to launch apps, switch themes, check the weather, draft an email, with suggested prompts and typewriter replies.
wn_recent_d: The Recommended area now dynamically shows recently used apps and recently opened files — click to open them directly.
wn_ctx2_d: Right-click the desktop for View, Sort by, and New submenus; right-click desktop icons to open, pin, rename, or delete.
wn_snap2_d: After snapping a window to one side, the remaining windows are listed so you can pick one to fill the rest of the screen.
wn_tv2_d: Virtual desktop thumbnails show their own wallpaper, desktops can be renamed, and each desktop can have a different wallpaper applied instantly when switched.
wn_tray_d: A new expand button on the right of the taskbar reveals background icons like OneDrive and Windows Security.
wn_boot_d: Restart or shut down shows the brand logo and a boot spinner before reaching the lock screen, for a more realistic flow.
cp_hello: Hi! I'm Copilot. I can open apps, switch dark or light mode, check the weather, draft an email, or clear notifications. What would you like to try?
cp_help: I can help you: open an app (try “open settings”), switch dark or light mode, check today's weather, draft an email, clear all notifications, or take a screenshot.
cp_app_not_found: I couldn't find an app named {name}. Would you like to open Settings, Mail, or Calendar instead?
cp_dark_on: Switched to dark mode — easier on the eyes.
cp_screenshot: Screenshot captured and saved to the Photos app.
cp_weather_reply: It's 22° and sunny in Beijing, with good air quality. The next three days will be around 21°, 19°, and 23°.
cp_mail_body:
Hi,

Hope you're doing well. Let's catch up soon.

Best regards!
cp_mail_done: I've drafted an email and opened the Mail app — you'll find it in Drafts.
welcome_body_v17: Installation complete. Try the new Copilot, Start menu recommendations, smart snap fill, and desktop context menus.
upd_up_to_date: Your device has the latest updates
upd_notif_body: The Windows 11 18.0 feature update has downloaded. Restart to finish installing.
upd_banner: Restart to finish the Windows 18.0 update
upd_hint: Stay connected to get the latest updates
sticky_empty: No notes yet. Click the button above to create one.
sticky_hint: Notes save automatically to your desktop
cap_line2: This feature shows speech captions on your screen.
cap_line3: You can toggle it in Quick Settings now.
cap_line4: Try playing a video to see it in action.
cap_line5: Position and text size are adjustable.
focus_complete: Great job! Your focus session is complete.
wn_desc18: 18.0 turns the desktop into a real workspace: Windows Update, Sticky Notes, Focus Sessions and Projecting arrive, plus accessibility gains like Live Captions, Magnifier and configurable widgets.
wn_sticky_d: Draggable colored notes on the desktop: create, recolor, delete and pin, with auto-saved content.
wn_captions_d: Toggle from Quick Settings; a floating bar shows simulated live transcription, adjustable for position and text size.
wn_magnifier_d: Full-screen zoom that follows the cursor, with a floating control bar to adjust 100%–400% zoom.
wn_widgets2_d: Add, remove and reorder widgets, including new Photos, Mail, To Do and world clock cards.
wn_focus2_d: 15/30/60-minute timed sessions that enable do-not-disturb, with a celebration and daily tally when you finish.
wn_project_d: A Win+P-style project panel with four modes; Extend or Second-screen shows a draggable second-display preview.
notif_v18_body: Seven new features: Windows Update, Sticky Notes, Live Captions, Magnifier, configurable widgets, Focus Sessions and multi-screen projecting.
welcome_body_v18: Setup is complete. Try the all-new Windows Update, Sticky Notes, Live Captions, Magnifier and Focus Sessions.
welcome_body_v19: Setup is complete. Try the new voice typing, emoji panel, color filters, power management and Phone Link.
wn_desc19: 19.0 rounds out input and accessibility: voice typing, an emoji panel, color filters and Game Bar, plus power management, System Restore and Phone Link.
wn_voice_d: Open it from Quick Settings and dictate into whatever field has focus, with a live floating panel.
wn_emoji_d: Browse emoji, gestures and symbols by category, insert with one click, and keep a recent list.
wn_filter_d: Apply grayscale, inverted or color-blind filters to the whole desktop, switchable at any time.
wn_power_d: See charge and estimated runtime, switch between Best performance, Balanced and Battery saver, and review the last seven days.
wn_gamebar_d: An overlay with live frame rate, CPU, GPU and VRAM usage, plus screenshot and recording timer.
wn_phone_d: Read and send messages, browse phone photos and mirror notifications on your PC.
voice_idle: Click the microphone to start dictating
voice_hint: Text is written to the focused field when a phrase ends
voice_p1: Please type this paragraph into the document.
voice_p2: Today's meeting is scheduled for three in the afternoon.
voice_p3: Remember to save the file you just edited.
voice_p5: This report is due tomorrow morning.
emoji_hint: Click an emoji to insert it into the focused field
filter_hint: Filters apply to the whole desktop immediately
power_tip_saver: Lowers power draw to last longer
restore_sub: Restore points record system files and settings so recent changes can be undone.
restore_confirm: Restore the system to this point?
restore_disk: Restore points use {p}% of disk space
gb_hint: Press Win+G to open or close Game Bar
phone_reply1: Got it, I'll get back to you soon.
phone_reply3: I've already taken care of it.
phone_notif2_d: Your parcel has arrived at the pickup point
welcome_body_v20: Setup is complete. Try the new Snipping Tool, Windows Security, OneDrive, Maps, Nearby sharing, Mobile hotspot and Sound Recorder.
wn_desc20: 20.0 rounds out capture, security and connectivity: Snipping Tool, Windows Security, OneDrive and Maps, plus Nearby sharing, Mobile hotspot and Sound Recorder.
wn_snip_d: Capture in rectangle, window or full-screen mode with an optional 3-second delay; shots land instantly in a recent gallery and can be copied or shared.
wn_security_d: Review virus protection, account protection, firewall, device security and app control in one place, with a one-click quick scan and live progress.
wn_onedrive_d: Check sync status and storage usage, pause or resume sync, browse recently synced files and free up space on demand.
wn_maps_d: Search for a place and drop an animated pin, zoom the map, toggle the traffic layer and jump to favorites.
wn_nearby_d: Open it from Quick Settings to discover nearby devices, pick one and send with a live transfer progress.
wn_hotspot_d: Share your Internet connection from your PC and see the network name, password, band and connected devices.
wn_recorder_d: Record audio with a live waveform; recordings are saved to a list and can be played back any time.
sec_scan_done: No threats found. Your device is secure.
sec_defs: Threat definitions are up to date
nb_hint: Pick a device to send a file or link
toast_scan_done: Quick scan complete: no threats found
lock_err_nopin: No PIN is set for this account. Use your password instead.
lock_err_nopass: No password is set for this account. Use your PIN instead.
lock_no_cred: No password or PIN set — you can sign in directly.
set_signin_desc: When set, the lock screen requires your password or PIN to reach the desktop.
set_cred_empty: Enter a new password or PIN
wn_desc201: 20.1 makes the password and PIN from setup actually work: the lock screen now verifies your credentials before opening the desktop, and you can change them anytime in Settings.
wn_cred_pass_d: The local account password you set during setup is enforced on the lock screen. A wrong password shows a retry message; only the correct one unlocks the desktop.
wn_cred_pin_d: Your Windows Hello PIN is now stored. The lock screen uses the PIN by default, and you can switch back to your password anytime.
wn_cred_opt_d: Check credential status, change or clear your password and PIN under Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options.
welcome_body_v201: Setup is complete. Your password and PIN are active — you'll need them to sign in from the lock screen.
